leads.general: Code, limits, classification, people and status.
leads.statements: Statements per language, with a live preview.
leads.editorial: The editorial, its visibility and its authors.
leads.data: The data package, checker settings and the test list.
leads.files: Images in the statement, the PDF statement and attached material.
leads.external: Judge this problem on a remote online judge instead of here.

indexLead: Open by code or search the list.
lookupHint: Paste a code to open the editor directly, without the list.

create.title: Create problem
create.lead: Without the right to add problems, the problem is sent as a suggestion for staff to review.

basics.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore (1 to 32 characters). Changing the code changes the address.
basics.name: Name
basics.nameHint: Up to 100 characters. Sent only when you edit it; per-language names live in the Statements tab.
basics.summaryHint: Shown in the problem list, up to 1000 characters.
basics.ogImageHint: Image address used when the problem link is shared; empty for none.

limits.partialHint: Score by the number of tests passed, not only when all pass.

visibility.feedbackHint: The checker's message for each test.

errors.code: Lowercase letters, digits, underscore, 1 to 32 characters.
errors.highTime: Over 5 seconds needs the “Set a high time limit” permission.
errors.types: At least one problem type is needed.

descriptions.basics: Source, publish date and the problem's preview.
descriptions.classes: Used by the public filters and for which languages can submit.
descriptions.visibility: What contestants see after they submit.
descriptions.people: Who edits, tests and sees the problem.

leads.info: The code and name show in the problem list. Limits apply to every language.
leads.publish: Off: only the problem's staff see it.

people.title: People in charge
people.orgPrivateHint: Only members of the listed organizations see the problem.

status.title: Status
status.dateOffer: Set the publication date to now, so the problem lists as new?

readiness.title: This problem may not be ready to publish:
readiness.noCases: It has no test cases, so every submission fails to judge.
readiness.noCasePoints: Its test cases are worth 0 points, so nobody can score.

clone.title: Clone {code}
clone.hint: Copies the statements, translations and test data.

statements.imageHint: An uploaded image is inserted at the cursor.
statements.fullMarkupNote: This problem uses full markup: the preview uses the plain style because you lack the “Use unsanitised problem markup” permission.

errors.character: Do not use the character {character}; use a plain one instead.

editorial.publicHint: When off, only staff and the authors see it.
editorial.publishOnHint: The editorial opens to everyone at this time (when publishing is on).

archive.title: Data archive
archive.lead: The zip, init.yml and the files inside it.
archive.note: Archive files only name the tests; download through their own link, never shown inline.

feedback.title: The last init.yml could not be generated

checker.title: Checker and grader
checker.jsonHint: Leave empty when there are no arguments. Must be a JSON object.

cases.title: Test list
cases.hardLimit: The “{permission}” permission allows up to {max} tests; this account has the usual limit.
cases.legend: C: single test · S: open a scored group · E: close the group. A group's points are the whole group's.
cases.badJsonRows: Fix the invalid JSON in test {rows} before saving.
cases.overMax: Over the limit of {max} rows; saving will be refused. Remove tests or groups.

errors.fileName: A file name is at most 100 characters and holds no NUL character.
errors.generatorArgs: Generator arguments are at most 1000 characters.
errors.count: Must be a whole number, zero or more.
errors.argsTotal: All test arguments together are over 1 MiB; shorten them.

autofill.title: Create tests from the zip
autofill.rules: Name files in one of these layouts: 1.in + 1.out, test01/task.inp + test01/task.out, input1.txt + output1.txt. Inputs end in .in or .inp or start with input; outputs end in .out, .ans or .ok or start with output.
autofill.skipped: Skipping {count} pairs already in the list.
autofill.totalHint: Split evenly across the tests; the remainder goes to the last tests. Edit each test's points afterwards.
autofill.unpairedHint: These files will not become tests. Check their names: a test's input and output must share a folder and a base name.
autofill.applied: Added {count} tests. Press “Save configuration” to save.

config.checkerDescription: How a submission's output is compared with each test's answer.

stock.label: Built-in
stock.description: Right for most problems; no file to upload.
stock.otherRule: A built-in rule. Change the rule on the Advanced tab.

testlib.label: Testlib
testlib.description: A C++ checker written with testlib.h (registerTestlibCmd).

themis.label: Themis
themis.description: Reads the test and work directories from stdin, prints a 0–1 score last.

default.label: Exit code
default.description: Gets input, output and answer; exit 0 is correct, 1 is wrong.

standard.label: Match answer (ignore extra whitespace)
standard.hint: Compares word by word, ignoring extra whitespace and blank lines.

floats.label: Floats
floats.hint: Numbers match within an absolute or relative error.

floatsabs.label: Floats, absolute error
floatsabs.hint: Numbers match when output minus answer is small enough.

floatsrel.label: Floats, relative error
floatsrel.hint: Numbers match when the relative error is small enough.

identical.label: Identical
identical.hint: The output must equal the answer byte for byte.

linecount.label: Line by line
linecount.hint: Compares line by line, each line word by word.

rstripped.label: Line by line, trailing spaces ignored
rstripped.hint: Lines must match after trailing whitespace is removed.

sorted.label: Any order
sorted.hint: Compares after sorting the lines (or the words).

unordered.label: Set of words
unordered.hint: Correct when the output has the answer's words in any order.

easy.label: Easy
easy.hint: Ignores all whitespace, letter case and character order.

linematches.label: Points per line
linematches.hint: Each line that matches the answer earns its share.

config.weightsHint: Whole numbers separated by spaces, e.g. 1 1 2; one per answer line.
config.peAllowed: Report a presentation error when only whitespace differs
config.fillerLinesHint: On: missing or extra lines are wrong.
config.checkerFileMissing: No checker file yet. The problem cannot be judged until one is uploaded.
config.percentageHint: On: "points 50" is 50% of the test. Off: "points N" is N points of the test.
config.themisHint: The checker finds files by the names in its source and by the file I/O names below. If it uses the problem's file names, choose "Files".
config.graderDescription: How a submission reads input and returns its result.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: The program reads input and prints output.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.description: The program talks to the problem's (testlib) interactor.

signature.label: Functions only
signature.description: Contestants write functions, linked with the problem's grader and header.

output_only.label: Output only
output_only.description: Contestants submit output files, not source code.

standard.label: stdin / stdout
standard.description: Read from standard input, print to standard output.

file.label: Files
file.description: Read and write files with fixed names.

config.interactorMissing: No interactor yet. The problem cannot be judged until one is uploaded.
config.allowMainHint: Off: a submission with main is refused.
config.outputLimitHint: Largest output in bytes. Empty: the judge default.
config.outputPrefixHint: Leading output bytes kept for review.
config.unicodeHint: Treat Unicode whitespace as whitespace when comparing.
config.nobigmathHint: Not supported by the current judge; a problem with it on cannot be judged.

errors.precision: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
errors.weights: At least one line needs points above 0.
errors.weightsFormat: Only whole numbers of 0 or more, separated by spaces.
errors.fileName: Enter a file name without / or \, not starting with a dot, other than input, output, main.

compile.error: Compile error: fix the source and upload it again.
compile.unavailable: No judge could check it. The problem still saves; any error shows when submissions are judged.

config.checkerOptionsDescription: The comparison rule and its options; the checker type is picked on the Basic tab.
config.checkerNoOptions: This checker type has no further options.
config.ioOtherGrader: A “{grader}” problem does not read input this way. Change the problem kind on the Advanced tab.

basic.summaryEmpty: No tests yet. Upload a zip, then press “Create tests from the zip”.
basic.summaryMore: Edit single tests, batches and pretests on the Advanced tab.

sources.title: Attached source files
sources.removeBody: The problem stops using this file until it is uploaded again.

image.title: Images in the statement
image.lead: Each upload returns an address to paste into the statement.

pdf.title: Statement PDF
pdf.lead: One PDF for the whole problem; a new upload replaces it.

files.removeBody: The problem will no longer have this file; upload a new one when needed.
